data.description:
## Context

The current `scripts/create-dso-app.sh` clones a hardcoded fork of Strata's NextJS template with DSO infrastructure baked into the fork's files. The fork is NextJS-only (precluding Strata SDK access, which is Rails-first) and detached from `platform-cli`'s install/upgrade lifecycle, so it drifts from upstream Strata over time. There's no way for a non-technical user to scaffold a Strata Rails+SDK+USWDS prototype with one command. This epic rewrites the installer to invoke `nava-platform app install` against upstream Strata templates (Rails default, pinned to v1.0.0), apply a DSO overlay, and deprecate the fork — using a phased script structure with extracted overlay engine and pre-implementation feasibility spike (already executed and recorded as a baseline at `tests/audits/A1-feasibility-spike-results.md`).

## In Scope

- Restructure `scripts/create-dso-app.sh` into six explicit phases: `parse-args` → `check-prereqs` → `invoke-platform-cli` → `apply-overlay` → `rails-sdk-add` → `emit-summary`. Each phase is a bash function; failures emit `[A1] phase=<name>` tagged errors and a "what to do next" hint.
- New shared script `plugins/dso/scripts/apply-host-overlay.sh` (the overlay engine): walks `plugins/dso/templates/host-project/`, applies `{{PROJECT_NAME}}` substitution per the existing installer convention, copies into target, leaves a one-line audit comment in dso-config.conf. Reusable beyond create-dso-app.sh.
- New in-plugin overlay tree `plugins/dso/templates/host-project/`: canonical DSO files (CLAUDE.md template, dso-config.conf, .pre-commit-config.yaml, project-understanding.md skeleton, design-notes.md skeleton, ARCH_ENFORCEMENT.md skeleton) with `{{PROJECT_NAME}}` placeholders matching the installer's substitution patterns.
- Ship `plugins/dso/scripts/lib/strata-config-defaults.conf` — shared canonical definition file mapping each Strata template variant to its `commands.*` values, Rails-Strata ARCH_ENFORCEMENT footguns, and Strata Posture section template. Single source of truth — sourced by A1's `apply-overlay` phase AND by A2's `prompts/strata/config-writes.md` + `arch-enforcement.md`. A1 MUST NOT independently define `commands.*` keys — sources from this file. A1 writes the FULL Posture section (not a skeleton) using install-time-known `_commit` and `_src_path`, so A2's onboarding-time idempotency check produces zero diffs.
- Tickets orphan-branch creation post-overlay; explicit `git push origin tickets` exit-code check; remote conflict surfaced with clear error and exit non-zero.
- CLI flags: `--app-name=<name>` (positional kept for back-compat plus added as flag), `--port=<num>` (default 3000), `--template=rails|nextjs|flask` (default rails), `--no-sdk` (skips Rails SDK gem add), `--no-overlay` (skips DSO overlay), `--auto-install-prereqs`, `--help`. Phase-tagged errors and recovery hints.
- Defensive guard against unknown Copier vars: at `check-prereqs`, parse upstream `copier.yml` at pinned commit hash (via `gh api`) and diff required-var list (name + type + accepted-values for enums) against hardcoded list in `plugins/dso/scripts/lib/strata-template-vars.sh` (where copier.yml is the source of truth and the hardcoded list is the script's coverage map). If any copier.yml-required var is NOT in the hardcoded list, fail fast with `[A1] copier.yml required var '<name>' not in --data list; update plugins/dso/scripts/lib/strata-template-vars.sh`. At `invoke-platform-cli`, hang detector (5s prompt-pattern + 60s no-output) as defense-in-depth.
- `nava-platform` install command pins to specific upstream tag/commit (per spike: v1.0.0 for `template-application-rails`); pinned ref documented in `strata-template-vars.sh`.
- Rails SDK gem-add (when `--template=rails` and not `--no-sdk`): single-line text-append of `gem "strata", github: "navapbc/strata-sdk-rails"` (gem name is `strata`, not `strata-sdk-rails`, per spike) to the generated `Gemfile`. Idempotent grep-before-append. No Ruby/bundler on host; user's first `make build` runs `bundle install` inside Docker.
- Project layout: `create-dso-app.sh my-prototype` flow creates `my-prototype/` as project root; runs `nava-platform app install --template-uri ... --version v1.0.0 --data app_name=app --data app_local_port=3000 . app` from inside `my-prototype/`. Result: `my-prototype/` is project root with DSO overlay (CLAUDE.md, dso-config.conf, ticket store dir, `.template-application-rails/app.yml`); `my-prototype/app/` is the Rails app. Canonical app subdirectory name: `app`.
- Overlay engine: collision-protection (refuses to overwrite by default; `--overlay-mode=skip|overwrite|merge` flag); binary-safety (text-extension whitelist + `file -b --mime` detection).
- Prereq install contract: OS matrix = macOS + Linux (Windows users directed to WSL2 via clear error). Package manager selection: macOS detects Homebrew (`brew install uv` if present, else `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh`); Linux uses official `curl` installer. After uv installer runs, unconditionally `export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"`; verify with `command -v nava-platform`; fail fast if not found. Failure semantics: prereq install failure aborts (no warn-and-continue). `--auto-install-prereqs` skips interactive confirmation; if NOT passed AND prompt would be required AND no TTY available, abort with `[A1] phase=check-prereqs no TTY for prereq prompt; pass --auto-install-prereqs for unattended`.
- Docker pre-flight check: detect Docker; emit clear pre-flight error if absent (with link to Docker Desktop install page). Docker is NOT auto-installed.
- `--app-name` validation: regex `^[a-z0-9\-_]+$` at parse-args; reject invalid names with clear error before any installation work.
- A1 MUST NOT write `commands.*` keys to `dso-config.conf` outside the shared-defaults file values — those values are A2's exclusive territory beyond the initial seeded set.
- Fork deprecation: `gh repo archive navapbc/digital-service-orchestra-nextjs-template --yes` (NOT `gh repo edit --archived=true`); idempotent per gh source. Sequencing: real-URL E2E test for new flow merged + green BEFORE fork archive commit; fork archive is final PR of the epic. Stderr redirected to log to avoid triggering surrounding error-handling.
- Update fork-URL references in source: `CLAUDE.md:56`, `plugins/dso/README.md:9`, `tests/scripts/test-create-dso-app-real-url.sh:11,33,34`, `docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md:270` (annotated `[deprecated; archived YYYY-MM-DD]`), `docs/onboarding.md:16`, `docs/designs/create-dso-app-template-contract.md` (rewritten), `docs/designs/dso-nextjs-starter-plugin-install.md:3`, `.github/workflows/template-real-url-e2e.yml:4`.
- Behavioral test extending the existing `test-create-dso-app-real-url.sh` opt-in pattern: scaffolds a Rails default, asserts the result has working app + USWDS + SDK gem in Gemfile + DSO overlay files + tickets orphan branch + post-build SDK functional check. Opt-in via `RUN_REAL_URL_E2E=1`; runs daily in CI.

## Out of Scope

- Infrastructure provisioning (`nava-platform infra install`) — future epic.
- Sample-feature scaffolding — Epic B / onboarding territory.
- Layer 4 microservices — Epic C (d08f-03d7-a148-43d0).
- Upstream contributions (`--no-input`, `--answers-file` for `platform-cli`; `gem "strata"` in upstream Rails template Gemfile) — filed as separate non-blocking tickets.
- Migration tooling for fork users — release-notes only.
- Retrofit-DSO-onto-existing-Strata-project tool — future epic that calls `apply-host-overlay.sh`.
- `commands.*` stack-conditional config writes beyond shared-defaults file values — Epic A2.

## Success Criteria

1. One-command Strata Rails+SDK+USWDS scaffold completes non-interactively. Non-technical user (Ruby NOT installed; uv NOT installed; Docker installed) runs `bash <(curl -fsSL .../create-dso-app.sh) my-prototype --auto-install-prereqs` and the script completes with exit zero and zero non-prerequisite interactive prompts. Result `my-prototype/` containing: (a) working Strata Rails app from upstream `template-application-rails@v1.0.0` (`make build` succeeds in Docker); (b) USWDS bundled (`@uswds/uswds@^3.7.1` in package.json); (c) `gem "strata", github: "navapbc/strata-sdk-rails"` present in Gemfile; (d) DSO overlay files with substituted PROJECT_NAME; (e) tickets orphan branch present + pushed if remote configured; (f) SDK functional check: post-build, `make rails-runner CMD='require "strata"; puts Strata::VERSION'` returns a non-empty version string. Additionally, the values written into `dso-config.conf`, `ARCH_ENFORCEMENT.md`, and `project-understanding.md`'s `## Strata Posture` section match what A2's `prompts/strata/*` sub-files would produce when run on the same scaffolded project state — verified by behavioral test asserting zero diffs in those three files. Verified by extending `tests/scripts/test-create-dso-app-real-url.sh`.

2. CLI flag variants produce documented outputs. `--template=nextjs` produces NextJS scaffold without SDK gem. `--template=flask` produces Flask scaffold without SDK gem. `--no-sdk` skips Gemfile append (verified by absence of gem line). `--no-overlay` produces clean upstream Strata scaffold without DSO overlay files. `--port=8080` propagates to upstream `app_local_port`. `--auto-install-prereqs` installs missing uv/nava-platform without prompting. All variants verified by behavioral tests.

3. Defensive guard fails fast at parse-time AND install-time. Parse-time test: synthetic upstream copier.yml with new required var → exit non-zero <10s with `[A1] copier.yml required var '<name>' not in --data list; update plugins/dso/scripts/lib/strata-template-vars.sh` BEFORE platform-cli invocation. Install-time test: simulated prompt-pattern in stderr → kill within 5s with same error class. No hung script in either path.

4. Overlay engine independently testable; collision-protected; binary-safe; idempotent. `apply-host-overlay.sh` invoked directly produces correct output; collision protection refuses overwrite by default; binary files (image/lock-file fixtures) NOT substituted; idempotent re-run (Gemfile dedup, no double-tickets-branch).

5. Fork archived after E2E test green; mechanical grep verification. Fork archive commit is the FINAL PR of the epic. CI for the fork-archive commit shows new E2E test passing. After landing: `gh api repos/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra-nextjs-template --jq .archived` returns `true`; fork README has redirect note; `git grep -l 'digital-service-orchestra-nextjs-template' HEAD -- ':!docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md'` returns zero matches; KNOWN-ISSUES entries annotated `[deprecated; archived YYYY-MM-DD]`.

## Scenario Analysis

11 surviving scenarios (red/blue team filter) all addressed via In Scope mitigations: nava-platform interactive hang protection (input redirect + hang detector); platform-cli version pinning; overlay collision detection (refuse overwrite by default); Gemfile idempotency (grep before append); tickets push exit-code handling; binary file safety in overlay (text-extension whitelist + MIME detection); uv prereq detection + offered install; real-URL E2E test updated BEFORE fork archive (sequencing constraint); --app-name regex validation; defensive guard upgrade (parse copier.yml at pinned hash AND install-time prompt detection).

## Approach

Phased script structure with extracted overlay engine. Defensive guard via hardcoded required-var lists pinned to upstream commit hashes (with copier.yml as source of truth, hardcoded list as coverage map — fail fast on divergence). Container-first Rails SDK installation (no host Ruby). Fork archived via `gh repo archive --yes`. Behavioral test via existing `test-create-dso-app-real-url.sh` opt-in pattern.

## Dependencies

No upstream blockers. Soft external dependency on `nava-platform` upstream availability via uv-installable git URL pinned to specific tag/commit. Coordination with A2: A1's overlay seeds the FULL Strata Posture section + commands.* + footguns from `strata-config-defaults.conf` at install time; A2's onboarding sources the SAME file → idempotent re-write produces zero diffs (verified by behavioral test). A1 ships `strata-config-defaults.conf` as part of plugin filesystem (not host-project artifact), so A2 has access to it regardless of whether A1's installer was used. A2 declares dependency on A1 for the shared file. Optional follow-on (filed as non-blocking tickets): upstream contribution of `--no-input`/`--answers-file` to `platform-cli` would simplify A1's defensive guard; upstream inclusion of `gem "strata"` in `template-application-rails` would remove the post-install gem-add step.
data.title: Strata-aware create-dso-app.sh rewrite (Rails+SDK+USWDS one-command default)
